# Segment 1 (0-17.8s) - Introduction
title = Text("HCF and LCM using Prime Factorization", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Using the Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
hcf_text = Text("HCF: Highest Common Factor", font_size=36).shift(UP)
lcm_text = Text("LCM: Lowest Common Multiple", font_size=36).shift(DOWN)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)

self.play(Write(lcm_text), run_time=2)

# Segment 2 (17.8-33.0s) - HCF Steps
hcf_steps = VGroup(
    Text("1. Express numbers as prime factors", font_size=32),
    Text("2. Identify common prime factors", font_size=32),
    Text("3. Take lowest power of each", font_size=32)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN)

self.play(FadeOut(hcf_text), FadeOut(lcm_text), run_time=1)
for step in hcf_steps:
    self.play(Write(step), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.2)

# Segment 3 (33.0-48.7s) - Prime factorization example
numbers = Text("24 and 60", font_size=36).shift(UP * 2)
fact_24 = MathTex(r"24 = 2^3 \times 3^1").shift(UP * 0.5)
fact_60 = MathTex(r"60 = 2^2 \times 3^1 \times 5^1").shift(DOWN * 0.5)

self.play(FadeOut(hcf_steps), run_time=1)
self.play(Write(numbers), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(fact_24), run_time=2)
self.play(Write(fact_60), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 4 (48.7-69.6s) - HCF Calculation
common_factors = MathTex(r"\text{Common factors: } 2^2 \times 3^1").shift(DOWN * 1.5)
hcf_result = MathTex(r"\text{HCF} = 12").shift(DOWN * 2.5)

self.play(Write(common_factors), run_time=3)
self.wait(3)
self.play(Write(hcf_result), run_time=3)
self.wait(11.8)

# Segment 5 (69.6-85.8s) - LCM Steps
lcm_steps = VGroup(
    Text("For LCM:", font_size=36),
    Text("1. Use all prime factors", font_size=32),
    Text("2. Take highest power of each", font_size=32)
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(numbers, fact_24, fact_60, common_factors, hcf_result)),
    run_time=2
)
for step in lcm_steps:
    self.play(Write(step), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.2)

# Segment 6 (85.8-109.2s) - LCM highest powers
highest_powers = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"2^3 \text{ (highest power of 2)}"),
    MathTex(r"3^1 \text{ (highest power of 3)}"),
    MathTex(r"5^1 \text{ (highest power of 5)}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(FadeOut(lcm_steps), run_time=1)
for power in highest_powers:
    self.play(Write(power), run_time=4)
self.wait(10.4)

# Segment 7 (109.2-132.0s) - LCM Result and Conclusion
lcm_calc = MathTex(r"\text{LCM} = 2^3 \times 3^1 \times 5^1 = 120").shift(DOWN * 2)
final_note = Text("A systematic approach using FTA!", font_size=36).shift(DOWN * 3)

self.play(Write(lcm_calc), run_time=4)
self.wait(10)
self.play(Write(final_note), run_time=3)

section_title: HCF and LCM in Word Problems
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0.0-16.8s) - Introduction
title = Text("HCF and LCM Word Problems", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Solving Real-World Problems", font_size=36).next_to(title, DOWN)

problem_box = RoundedRectangle(height=3, width=5, corner_radius=0.2)
problem_text = Text("Word\nProblem", font_size=32).move_to(problem_box)
problem_group = VGroup(problem_box, problem_text).shift(LEFT * 3)

solution_box = RoundedRectangle(height=3, width=5, corner_radius=0.2) 
solution_text = Text("Solution", font_size=32).move_to(solution_box)
solution_group = VGroup(solution_box, solution_text).shift(RIGHT * 3)

arrow = Arrow(problem_group.get_right(), solution_group.get_left(), buff=0.5)

self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=1.5)
self.play(
    Create(problem_box),
    Write(problem_text),
    Create(solution_box), 
    Write(solution_text),
    Create(arrow),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(10.3)

# Segment 2 (16.8-29.9s) - Distinguishing HCF vs LCM
hcf_box = RoundedRectangle(height=2.5, width=4, corner_radius=0.2, color=BLUE)
hcf_text = Text("HCF", font_size=36, color=BLUE).next_to(hcf_box, UP)
hcf_desc = Text("Equal Groups\nLargest Measure", font_size=24).move_to(hcf_box)
hcf_group = VGroup(hcf_box, hcf_text, hcf_desc).shift(LEFT * 3 + DOWN)

lcm_box = RoundedRectangle(height=2.5, width=4, corner_radius=0.2, color=RED)
lcm_text = Text("LCM", font_size=36, color=RED).next_to(lcm_box, UP)
lcm_desc = Text("Common Occurrences\nSmallest Common", font_size=24).move_to(lcm_box)
lcm_group = VGroup(lcm_box, lcm_text, lcm_desc).shift(RIGHT * 3 + DOWN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(problem_group, solution_group, arrow)),
    FadeIn(hcf_group),
    FadeIn(lcm_group),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(10.2)

# Segment 3 (29.9-51.8s) - Examples
example_hcf = Text(
    "Example (HCF):\nDivide 24 chocolates &\n36 candies equally",
    font_size=24
).next_to(hcf_box, DOWN, buff=0.5)

example_lcm = Text(
    "Example (LCM):\nBuses arrive every\n15 & 20 minutes",
    font_size=24
).next_to(lcm_box, DOWN, buff=0.5)

self.play(
    Write(example_hcf),
    Write(example_lcm),
    run_time=4
)

highlight_box = SurroundingRectangle(example_hcf, color=YELLOW, buff=0.2)
self.play(Create(highlight_box), run_time=1)
self.play(highlight_box.animate.move_to(example_lcm), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeOut(highlight_box), run_time=1)
self.wait(13.8)

# Segment 4 (51.8-70.6s) - Problem-solving steps
steps = VGroup(
    Text("1. Read carefully", font_size=28),
    Text("2. Identify key words", font_size=28),
    Text("3. Choose HCF or LCM", font_size=28),
    Text("4. Solve systematically", font_size=28)
).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT, buff=0.5).move_to(ORIGIN)

self.play(
    FadeOut(VGroup(hcf_group, lcm_group, example_hcf, example_lcm)),
    run_time=2
)

for step in steps:
    self.play(Write(step), run_time=2)
self.wait(8.8)

# Segment 5 (70.6-78.2s) - Conclusion
final_text = Text("You can do it!", font_size=48, color=GREEN)
self.play(
    FadeOut(steps),
    FadeIn(final_text),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(5.6)
